messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 — increased latency and error spike observed on /v1/generate (hosted). Auto-paging oncall. traces: https://infralogs/internal/1850012345

maria (oncall): acked. Looking at p95 and 5xxs now. Seeing big tail starting ~2026-03-15T02:01:00Z. P95 jumped from 120ms -> ~1.8s, tok/sec down ~30%.

sean: I see a canary that rolled a quantized build (q4) ~01:58Z. KV cache eviction + format mismatch between q4 and q8 variants likely causing cache-misses -> regen + longer decode.

arun: if it's KV format mismatch then cache misses will make batching fill up and increase latency. Immediate mitigation: route traffic away from canary to stable model and rollback quantization flag.

maria (oncall): on it. Switching routing policy to prefer model:open-llama-v2-stable (non-quant) and starting rollback for canary.

maria (oncall): changing routing via admin API:
```
POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/routes/switch
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "model": "open-llama-v2-stable", "percent": 100 }
```

ops-bot: deployment-change: routing update applied by maria at 2026-03-15T02:04:10Z.

lina: also recommend temporarily reducing continuous batching window to avoid huge batches accumulating while cache warms. small tweak: lower batching.max_wait_ms from 50 -> 10.

kate: note that flushing the global KV namespace will cause cold-start but may be OK for canary nodes. Suggest flushing only affected prefixes: `kv.flush(prefix="quant-q4-canary-")`

sean: agree. Blunt rollback + targeted prefix flush on canary hosts. I'll run the flush on canary set and monitor.

maria (oncall): running rollback (quant flag off) and targeted flush now.

sean: flush command run on 3 canary hosts:
```
for host in canary-01 canary-02 canary-03; do ssh $host "redwood-kv flush --prefix quant-q4-canary-"; done
```

maria (oncall): batching window reduced, routing switched, targeted flush completed. Metrics starting to improve. P95 trending down.

ops-bot: alert-suppression: auto-mute on /v1/generate for 10m while mitigations in flight.

maria (oncall): customer impact: ~12 small customers saw transient increased latency, 2 enterprise customers saw errors >2s for ~6 minutes. No data loss. Notifying CS for those two enterprises.

kate: can we also enable strict KV compatibility check in the router to avoid cross-format traffic? If routing ever sends q4 hits to q8 cached keys we'll get big misses.

arun: that should be a config toggle; but we need a longer-term fix to model onboarding: require KV format compatibility guarantee or run a migration step.

sean: mitigation successful — P95 back to baseline ~130ms, errors down to normal at 02:12Z.

maria (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. Initiating post-incident review thread and scheduling postmortem. Proposed time: 2026-03-16 09:00 PT. Calendar invite: https://calendar.internal/meet/pm-1850012345

maria (oncall): quick action items (assigning now):
- sean: add gating check to model rollout pipeline to detect KV cache format mismatches (owner: sean) — due 2026-03-17 (48h).
- arun: implement runtime router strict-compat toggle and a fallback policy to prevent cross-format routing (owner: arun) — due 2026-03-22 (7d).
- lina: add an automated test in CI to catch batching-window regressions and measure latency under simulated cache-miss load (owner: lina) — due 2026-03-29 (14d).
- kate: update operational runbook with explicit targeted KV flush steps and rollback playbook (owner: kate) — due 2026-03-18 (3d).
- maria: customer communications template + coordinate CS outreach (owner: maria) — due 2026-03-17 (48h).

sean: I'll also add a model-onboard unit test that verifies serialized KV schema/version header present and fails the canary if mismatch. Plan: add preflight in model deploy job.

lina: will add a synthetic load job that simulates 100% cache-miss and measures p50/p95 under current batching; hook into CI so we catch regressions early.

arun: I'll prototype router flag today and post a PR. For long-term we should consider embedding KV version in routing key so incompatible variants never share namespace.

kate: updating runbook now. I'll include the exact curl commands and RBAC steps. Also adding a monitoring panel for 'kv_cache_hit_rate by model_variant' and an alert when hit_rate < 90% for 5m.

maria (oncall): assigning owners in the incident tracker: https://tracker.internal/1850012345/actions. Please add short status updates there when you make progress.

sean: noted. Starting work after standup.

kate: quick follow-up: add a post-deploy smoke that simulates 10 warm requests and 2 cold requests to validate performance after quantization changes. Owner: kate — due 2026-03-20.

maria (oncall): thanks all. Postmortem draft will be posted in this thread by EOD tomorrow. Please keep comments limited to action confirmations so we can consolidate. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: incident-closed: mitigation confirmed and postmortem scheduled.

sean: :thumbsup: good catch.

lina: :eyes: will add tests.

kate: :white_check_mark: runbook updated (draft).
